listing.summary: Currently, this includes the following autosaves:
listing.aiSummary: Adds autosave functionality on jumps, transactions, and after battles, with optional periodic normal saves.

description:
I wanted an updated version of autosave so I created my own version of it.

Requirements
LazyLib v3.0
LunaLib v2.0.3

Currently, this includes the following autosaves:

On jump
On transaction
After battle

The mod uses the new autosave slots for autosaves and includes the option to create a normal save after a specific period.
By default, all autosaves are enabled, and normal saves are disabled, but they can all be configured from Luna settings.
